item.title: Incarico di ricerca: “Environmental Intelligence: anticipating compound climate risks using Big Spatial Data and Statistical AI” (Univ. del SALENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-12 23:59
Institution: Univ. del SALENTO, Lecce
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-01 Statistica

The ecological transition poses a distributive challenge: air pollution and heat stress are often concentrated in areas characterized by socioeconomic vulnerability. Environmental Intelligence develops a Statistical AI framework to integrate Big Spatial Data from monitoring stations, satellites, climate reanalyses and administrative records. The aim is to estimate and predict exposure to PM2.5, NO₂ and heat stress, including in poorly monitored areas, and to analyse their association with socioeconomic vulnerability.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-04 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-09 Economia degli intermediari finanziari e finanza aziendale

The research examines how access to finance translates into real economic outcomes, focusing on financial instruments and channels outside traditional banking. It explores how their use and effects vary across households, firms and regions and depend on economic and institutional conditions. Three dimensions guide the analysis: digitalization, which may expand access beyond traditional financial infrastructure; informality, which shapes interactions with formal financial markets; and financial literacy, which influences financial choices and effective use of services. The empirical work combines World Bank Global Findex and Enterprise Surveys with household, firm and regional evidence.…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Causality Assessment in Pharmacovigilance: from Traditional to AI-driven Approaches (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-01 Statistica

The research project aims to review, explore, and operationalize recent advances in pharmacovigilance at the intersection of machine learning and causal inference, collectively termed causal machine learning. The goal is to go beyond the detection of purely association-based signals by developing a prototype analytical workflow that supports a more reliable, interpretable and robust causal assessment of drug safety signals.

item.description:

Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-07 Economia e gestione delle imprese

The VIS-HM project investigates the role of visual signals in digital hospitality markets by examining how the characteristics of Airbnb accommodation images influence bookings, occupancy, and revenue. The study considers seven dimensions: colour temperature, human presence, photographic composition, brightness, image quality, visual complexity, and multisensory evocation.
